critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1298-1313 batch-fetches alias+photo for distinct senders in one query. N+1 safe.
clear_public() (server.py:121) omits location.coords/email/password_hash - PublicProfile route is safe.

GroupDetail.jsx correctly separates mine vs !mine: my messages render Avatar directly (no Link, no alias label), other-user messages render <Link to=/app/usuario/{uid}> around both avatar AND alias. Alias appears above the bubble on the left column.

ChatDetail.jsx header Avatar+alias both wrapped in <Link to=/app/usuario/{other.id}>. Incoming text messages render msg-other-avatar Link; system + plan_proposal kinds correctly skip the avatar (early return).
PublicProfile.jsx: report modal state stays local; pp-report-submit disabled until a category is chosen. POST /report/block wired.
send() error path in both chat pages restores the text via setText(t) after the failed POST — the user's typing is not lost on rate-limit or transient error. This is a real UX win.

MINOR: PublicProfile.jsx line 21 does nav(-1) on load failure - if user landed on the URL directly (deep-link), nav(-1) may leave app in a weird state (goes to browser prior page). Consider nav('/app/descubrir') as safer fallback.
MINOR: GroupDetail.jsx uses 6s polling for chat updates. For a busy group this creates noticeable lag; consider 3-4s or SSE. Not blocking.
